records.rule: Let the editor own canonical object paths and common vocabulary; authors supply semantic content.
Change one identified sphere object at a time and return before/after digests.
Machine-resolvable citation fields are authoritative; explanatory note is opaque prose.
PROVENANCE_PANIC regression: a note may say `la la la ... oh I mean line ...` while correct structured artifact/member/line provenance remains valid.
Mechanically reliable detection can be a rule; judgement-heavy guidance remains an article.
Material review corrections should become versioned durable lessons and regression evidence where possible.
Do not invade engine behavior merely to make one sphere's content shape work when a canonical sphere-level representation suffices.
One narrow, deeply grounded sphere that preserves hard-won engineering culture is more useful than a broad shallow survey or duplicated source tree.
Ground a lesson in a real contract/incident/artifact, or clearly label it portable knowledge; never fabricate an incident to make guidance look authoritative.
Pair the how with the why: technique without doctrine invites a future model to preserve the syntax while breaking the contract.
Capture the mistake near the incident, classify article versus rule by trigger reliability, publish it, then surface it before the next worker repeats it.
Do not fork the engine for a private sphere shortcut; use shared capabilities/inheritance, and promote only genuinely common mechanism gaps into the engine.
Validate, lint, test, query through Gopher, qualify, version material changes, and package the exact qualified tree.
